verdict.rationale: Pigment's docs say it is "integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports," and its official MCP server lets external assistants query metrics, scoped by role, model, or metric. Neither item describes a documented export or data API for pulling metrics, forecasts, or scenario results into a warehouse or internal tool, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. missing for 10: documented export/read API for model outputs, warehouse connector or scheduled export, API reference/OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration.
